title_hi_from_in: राजा दशरथ का पुत्र के लिये अश्वमेधयज्ञ का प्रस्ताव और मन्त्रियों तथा ब्राह्मणों द्वारा उनका अनुमोदन
title_en_from_in: King Dasharatha proposes an Ashwamedha Yajna for a son, which is approved by ministers and Brahmins
intro_en_from_net: Chapter [Sarga] 8 Dasharatha decides to perform an elaborate Vedic ritual, called Aswamedha yajna, Horse Ritual, to beget children. He being a considerate king in taking conscience of the courtiers, he discusses this aspect with the Vedic scholars and ministers of his court, beforehand.
